traits.name: Attack of Opportunity
traits.text: ⬲ An athach gains an extra reaction at the start of each of its turns that it can use only to make an Attack of Opportunity with its claw. It can't use more than one Attack of Opportunity triggered by the same action.

traits.name: Athach Venom
traits.text: (poison); Saving Throw DC 32 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 2d6 (2d6) poison damage and enfeebled 1 (null) Stage 2 2d6 (2d6) poison damage and enfeebled 2 (null)

traits.name: Swift Claw
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The athach hits a creature with two fist Strikes Effect The athach makes a claw Strike with no multiple attack penalty against the creature it hit with its fist Strikes. This claw attack does not increase the athach's multiple attack penalty.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +25 Damage 3d8+13 (3d8+13) piercing plus athach venom

actions.name: Ranged
